sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 743 was established by Ordinance No. 26233, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 8, 2006. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 743 is established on property located near the intersection of Kiwanis Road and Grady Niblo Road. The size of PD 743 is approximately 51.8 acres. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article:

(1) PRIVATE RECREATION CENTER means an area providing private recreational facilities such as playgrounds, parks, game courts, camp grounds including cabins and tents, swimming pools, playing fields, program areas, and facilities to accommodate camping participants. This use may include facilities for the care and maintenance of grounds, animals, structures, and machinery.

(2) PRIVATE STABLE means an area for keeping horses for the private use of the property owner or the owner of the horse. This includes barns and indoor storage facilities for horse equipment, horse tack, and hay.

(3) PATRON LODGING means a lodging facility that provides room and board to persons using a private recreation center, private stable, or church on the Property. This use may include facilities that negotiate sleeping arrangements for any period of time.

(4) RESIDENT, STAFF, AND CARETAKER LODGING means a facility that provides room and board to persons assisting in the operation of a private recreation center, private stable, or church on the Property. This use may include dwelling units or suites that are exclusively restricted to members of the staff.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 743A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with a development plan approved by the city plan commission in compliance with the conceptual plan. In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Prior to approval of a development plan for any portion or all of the Property, the owner must provide a survey indicating the boundary of the escarpment zone on the Property. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the A(A) Agricultural District apply.

(b) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet except that cellular towers, structures for utility and public service uses, and institutional uses may be constructed to any legal height consistent with the Federal Aviation Administration air space limitations, airport flight overlay district regulations, residential proximity slope height restrictions, and the building code.

(c) Lot size. No minimum lot size. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

A minimum of 80 off-street parking spaces are required. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Escarpment Zone Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.110. ESCARPMENT ZONE REGULATIONS.

See Article V. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.112. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided in accordance with a city plan commission approved landscape plan that imposes landscape requirements that are reasonably consistent with the standards and purposes of Article X, with due regard to the existing landscaping and vegetation on the Property. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation, except as provided in Subsection (b).

(b) Paving shall be required for all required fire apparatus access roads as designated on the conceptual plan. Paving shall be required for parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections designated on the conceptual plan as paved area. Paving material must consist of either two inches of crushed rock or two inches of gravel. Paving is not required for parking areas designated as overflow parking as shown on the conceptual plan.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the City of Dallas. (Ord. 26284)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-743.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 743 is located on Zoning Map Nos. N-4 and O-4. (Ord. Nos. 26284; 26894)
